messages:
Casey: Quick Q from today's all-hands — for the June offsite, are we expected to book travel through the travel portal or can we self-book and expense? Also what's the per-person travel cap and are shuttles/taxis covered?
Priya (People Ops): Hi! Please use the Travel Portal (Concur) for flights/hotels so we get corporate rates. If you must self-book, please get pre-approval from People Ops (DM me or @People Ops). Domestic cap is $800 per person; for longer coast-to-coast flights we approve higher on a case-by-case basis. Taxis/shuttles under $75/day are reimbursable — receipts required.
Liam: If we self-book do we still get per-diem for meals?
Riley: Yes — per diem is $60/day domestic, $85/day international. Expense must be submitted within 30 days of travel.
Casey: Thanks — and quick follow-up: I tried to reserve a desk at the SF hub for that week and got waitlisted. Any tips?
OpsBot: Desk booking reminder — reserve via https://redwood.internal/desk. Waitlist auto-notifies when a spot frees. Overflow hot-desk area is on 3rd floor; if you need a guaranteed seat request a hub-pass at https://redwood.internal/hub-pass.
Jordan: One more — contractors traveling for the offsite, will Redwood provide visa/letter support?
Priya (People Ops): Short-term travel letters are available; for anything requiring formal visa support we need 6 weeks notice and coordinator sign-off. Contractors should loop in their recruiter and cc people-ops@redwood.com.
Casey: And the social meetups — is there a stipend or reimbursement for team dinners?
Priya (People Ops): Yes — there's a $50 per-person social stipend for all-hands meetups. Submit receipts to expenses@redwood.com and include code ALLHANDS2026 so it's flagged correctly.
Liam: :thumbsup: useful — thanks Priya
Riley: Also FYI the travel portal has a 'preferred hotels' filter that shows negotiated rates.
Casey: Last Q — what's the expected reimbursement turnaround? Two pay cycles still?
Priya (People Ops): Correct — reimbursements usually post within 2 pay cycles after approval. If your expense is urgent or missed, ping me directly and we'll escalate.
Casey: Awesome, appreciate it. I'll DM for a small exception.
